fullContentHtml:
Short Information : Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS), has released a Notification for the Navodaya Vidyalaya JNV Selection Test for Class IX (2027 – 2028) on the official website of the NVS recently. Online registration process for NVS Class 9 Online Form 2026 has Started from 02 September 2026 & the candidate Can apply till the 30 September 2026. The entrance examination will be held on 10 April 2027. Candidates must check the complete details for NVS Class 9th Online form 2026 direct link given below.

Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS)

NVS Class 9th Online Form 2026

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 02 September 2026
  • Last Date : 30 September 2026
  • Exam Date : 10 April 2027
  • Admit Card : Notify Soon
  • Result : Will Be Updated Here Soon

Application Fee

  • There is no Application Fee for all categories

[adinserter block=”3″]

NVS Class 9 Admissions Online Form 2027: Age Limit

  • Candidates must not have been born before 01-May-2012 and after 31-July-2014.
  • Use Tool –

NVS Class 9 Admissions 2027: Examination Details

  • Exam Name : Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya Selection Test (JNVST) – 2027
  • Class of Admission : Class-IX (9th) 
  • Total School : 653

NVS Class 9 Admissions 2027 : Qualification 

  • Candidates who are bonafide residents and must have passed the Class 8th Examination in one of the Govt./Govt. recognized schools of the district where the Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya is functioning and where admission is sought.
  • Candidate must be a Resident of the District where the Navodaya School is Open.
  • For More Details regarding Eligibility Criteria, Candidates must read the official notification.

How To Apply NVS Class 9 Admissions 2027

  • Candidates can apply through link https://navodaya.gov.in or provided below in link section or they can also apply through official site of the NVS before Last Date.
  • You Can Check other  Notification Here – 
  • For all the interested and eligible candidates who want to apply forNVS Class 9th Admission can read all the information related to the recruitment is given below and the link to apply is given in the Important Link section below.
  • Note – छात्रो से ये अनुरोध किया जाता है की वो अपना फॉर्म भरने से पहले Official Notification (Last Date, Age Limit, Qualification) को ध्यान से जरूर पढे उसके बाद ही अपना फॉर्म भरे ।

Documents to be Uploaded for NVS Class 9 Admission 2027

  • Recent Passport-Sized Photograph
  • Signature
  • 10th Mark Sheet & Certificate
  • 12th Mark Sheet & Certificate (if applicable)
  • Graduation Mark Sheet & Certificate (for PG courses)
  • Category Certificate (if applicable)
  • Domicile Certificate (if required)
  • ID Proof (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, etc.)

NVS Class 9 Application Form 2027 : Mode of Selection

  • Selection will be based on Written Examination (Question Paper will be framed on the basis of Class 8th level including Mental Ability Test, Arithmetic Test & Language Test. For All Details Candidates must read official notification.
